definition: Executions that ran through a bound authorization divided by all agent tool calls the tenant observed in the period
target_for_first_workflow: >= 0.9 for the tools named in FIRST_WORKFLOW.md
why_it_matters: An advisory deployment is not protection; this is the only number that says whether Sentinel was in the path
not_a_proxy_for: security posture (an enforced no-op tool proves nothing)

definition: Median seconds from authorization issued in pending_approval to a human decision
source_of_truth: authorizations table: decided_at minus issued_at, per tenant
why_it_matters: Approval that takes hours is bypassed by the humans who own the pipeline
Tail latency is what an on-call engineer remembers

target_for_first_workflow: breaker) that the tenant later judged legitimate divided by all refusals
not_a_proxy_for: execution_operations state=refused joined to the tenant's review notes
column11: A control that refuses good changes is switched off; this is the churn predictor
column12: detection precision (a refusal is not a detection)

definition: Operations that reached unknown_after_effect in the period
why_it_matters: Each one is a human reconciliation and a reason not to trust the receipt chain

definition: 95th percentile seconds from unknown_after_effect to reconciled
why_it_matters: How long the evidence chain stayed ambiguous

definition: Receipts the tenant's own verifier (standard/execution-passport-v1) validated divided by receipts issued
why_it_matters: Evidence that cannot be verified independently is a log, not evidence

definition: 95th percentile seconds between an execution completing and its receipt appearing in the tenant's SIEM
source_of_truth: tenant SIEM ingestion timestamp minus receipt completed_at
why_it_matters: The SOC integration promise is a latency promise

definition: Calendar days from tenant creation to the first execution that ran under enforcement with a bound authorization
source_of_truth: tenants.created_at to first execution_operations row with state=succeeded under SENTINEL_PROTECT_ENFORCE=true
why_it_matters: Onboarding cost is the number a buyer compares against a build-it-yourself gateway

definition: Distinct agent identities with at least one bound execution in the week
target_for_first_workflow: grows week over week during the pilot
why_it_matters: Adoption inside the tenant; flat means the pilot stalled

definition: Refusals the tenant attributes in writing to a prevented harmful change
source_of_truth: tenant statement with the operation ids
why_it_matters: The only outcome metric a buyer will repeat to a peer; it must be theirs, not ours

definition: Minutes in which POST /v1/protect/evaluate answered within 1 second divided by minutes in the period
why_it_matters: A gate that is down is a gate that gets removed

definition: Whether the tenant agreed in writing to be named and quoted
why_it_matters: Funding readiness requires a nameable customer
